support_geometry.sample_selection: Last pre-actuation row, first active row, every tenth active-or-later row, first horizontal crossing, peak angular speed, and terminal row; deduplicated in trace order.
support_geometry.foot_position_limitation: Retained foot-site positions, not floor clearance or proof of load. Qualifying load is counted separately using the unchanged native contact rule.
support_geometry.velocity_limitation: Applied motor velocity requests, not measured joint velocities or guaranteed motion.
